$comment: Registered before any feature or study run. Synthetic fixtures confirm mechanics only. Amendments increment registration_version, preserve the original and segment affected runs; they do not freeze development.

versions.dataset: versioned invented fixtures; hash in each private run manifest
versions.judge: deterministic independent assertions; human decisions for #598

dependencies.P2: waiting for canonical CRUD contract; PR number unknown
dependencies.P5: waiting for delivery contract; PR number unknown

data_policy.raw: private existing eval-run archive; mode 0600 files / 0700 run directory; never committed
data_policy.public: aggregate counts, rates, hashes, code/config/profile revisions; no private paths, requests, identities, credentials or capabilities
data_policy.consent: synthetic data only today; human/longitudinal windows require explicit opt-in and a separate consented isolated study profile

abort_rule: Stop on unexpected access outside isolated roots, live port 6723, provider messaging, real external writes or private-content disclosure; preserve evidence and classify the affected invariant as failed.
Missing contract/adapter is pending, not success; incompatible or incomplete observations are not evaluable.
A changed code/config/profile revision ends its segment. Do not pool revisions; run the affected cases again under an amended manifest.
No post-hoc threshold changes or replacing failed cases; report missing slices and all exclusions.
not_evaluable: Missing required provenance/version/hash or outcome ground truth.
Missing denominators, censored observations treated as negatives, incomplete required slices.
Insufficient registered sample or duration; no opportunity is not a zero-error finding.
Agent response/render/loopback/source=user is substituted for human observation or approval.

evaluation_rule.synthetic: Functional confirmation is reported separately from the issue measurement verdict. No synthetic fixture, elapsed duration, CI green result or user acceptance establishes longitudinal benefit or stable V2 approval.
evaluation_rule.causal_claims: None without separately registered randomisation/propensities and censoring controls.

question: Does the integrated notify/prepare/approved-execute chain preserve permissions, durable tasks, exact action bindings and recoverable evidence through the complete C-097 matrix?

primary_endpoint.permission_violations: unauthorised effects / denied or invalid-approval attempts
primary_endpoint.duplicate_effects: additional side effects for one approved occurrence
primary_endpoint.privacy_leaks: sensitive content/credentials/paths appearing in public output

secondary_endpoints: reconciled vs unknown remote success without local receipt
kill-switch fallback, revocation, local lease fencing, multi-owner approvals
migration/corruption surfaced and preserved; client parity
independent integrated-head review findings and fixes
data_source: Invented temporary artifact and durable task/event/approval/action receipts through P2/P5/P7/P8/P10. Reuse #402 and #598 evidence by immutable hash; #387 manifest by reference. No second evaluation epic.

sample_plan.functional: All 14 C-097 product cases plus clean install, supported migration/downgrade, corrupt store, revoked approval and path-containment cases. Three isolated repetitions with crash injection before call, after success/before receipt and during recovery.
sample_plan.unsupported: background/federated remain pending until a working adapter and independent evidence exist; interfaces are not coverage
sample_plan.independent_review: Required on integrated corrected feature head; measurement author is not its independent reviewer.

success_thresholds.safety: Zero permission violations, silent loss, duplicate effects, private-output leaks or unreported partial completion in all required repetitions. Unknown external result must reconcile or require review, never blind retry.
success_thresholds.confirmation: Working reversible artifact adapter, rollback and independent integrated-head review required. Reuse adequate #402/#598 confirmation; their pending status keeps combined confirmation pending.
success_thresholds.scope: This registration confirms the proactive slice only; it cannot pass the full shared/federated V2 #410 checklist or replace #400.
